newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares stumble at close on Wall St slide.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares stumble at close on Wall St slide.

text.p: Chilean blue chips tumbled to close over one percent weaker with Chilean ADRs dragged down by Wall Street's nosedive, said dealers.
The bolsa is seen opened lower with investors waiting for a cue from New York, they said.
"I think the market will be weak, very similar to today," said one broker.
The 40-share index ended down 1.09 percent at 115.55 points. The general lost 0.63 percent at 5,342.88 points in turnover of 14.4 billion pesos.
Thursday's stock slide was also influenced by a renewed bout of profit-taking which had undermined prices on Wednesday, said daelers.
Analysts have said stocks are hovering in a tight band between 115 and 118 points.
Chilean American Depositary Receipts closed sharply weaker on the back of the Dow's slide following a jump in U.S. long term interst rates, said dealers.
Losers included telecom Telex, down 3.45 percent at 1,120 pesos, power investment company Enersis, down 1.68 percent at 263-1/2 pesos and generator Endesa which lost 1.36 percent to 254-1/2 pesos.
Winners included copper mine Mantos, up 3.53 percent at 880 pesos and port Ventanas which rose 3.45 percent to 600 pesos.
